content: Traditional Postgres TCP connections exhaust pools under classic (non-Fluid) Vercel serverless concurrency. Recommended: Neon Postgres with @neondatabase/serverless driver in HTTP mode (neon() function) for simple per-request queries -- no persistent connection state, low latency, ideal for one-query-per-invocation serverless handlers. WebSocket/Pool mode only needed for interactive transactions. Alternative: Vercel Postgres (Neon-backed) with attachDatabasePool + pg pool if using Vercel Fluid Compute (functions kept warm).
